name: claude-code-development
description: Opinionated senior engineering team for Claude Code: software-developer, software-architect, code-planner, code-reviewer, quality-engineer, security-engineer, debugger, data-engineer — composable LEGO pieces with transversal practices (evidence levels, code-grounded analysis, risk scoring, tool-surface inventory, no-silent-drift, outputs-as-content) — plus methodology-anchored skills bundled and wired: adr, test-plan, development-plan, work-splitting, bug-analysis, threat-model, tech-spec, debugging-protocol, code-audit, code-review-checklist, git-commit, mermaid, external-research, coding-practices, data-modeling, schema-evolution. Single-responsibility scope, least-privilege tooling, no orchestration baked in (caller's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md owns it). v2 renames the tech-lead agent to code-planner: the agents in this team are organized by function (code-planning, threat-modelling, debugging, etc.), not by role — a real-world team lead does many functions; this agent covers one.
